description:
Reid eComfort ST eBike | Electric Commuter Bike
Comfortable, practical and designed for everyday journeys – the Reid eComfort eBike is an electric comfort commuter bike built for relaxed city riding, daily commuting and longer leisure rides.
The Reid eComfort combines a comfortable riding position with smooth electric assistance, making it an ideal choice for riders looking for a convenient and enjoyable way to get around. Its lightweight alloy frame features a neatly integrated battery for a clean, streamlined appearance and balanced ride. Designed with everyday comfort in mind, the eComfort makes travelling around town and enjoying longer rides easier.
Electric assistance provides a natural boost up to 20mph, helping you tackle hills and headwinds with less effort. The Ananda D19 handlebar-mounted display keeps essential ride information clearly visible and offers Bluetooth technology and app compatibility. Simple 7-speed gearing provides practical options for navigating urban streets, cycle paths and varied everyday terrain.
Designed for stability and control, the eComfort features wide 27.5-inch tyres that provide cushioning and grip on roads and shared paths. A rigid fork offers a straightforward, dependable setup for everyday cycling, while powerful hydraulic disc brakes deliver responsive stopping power to help you ride with confidence in changing conditions.
Every detail supports a relaxed and comfortable riding experience. Upright handlebars encourage a natural riding position, while ergonomic grips and a comfort saddle help reduce pressure on your hands and seat during longer journeys. Combined with its lightweight alloy frame and easy-to-use gearing, the eComfort is designed to make regular cycling more accessible and enjoyable.
Whether you're commuting to work, running errands around town or heading out for a leisurely weekend ride, the Reid eComfort eBike offers a practical way to travel with less effort. With smooth electric assistance, comfort-focused components and a versatile design, it's a reliable option for everyday journeys and relaxed recreational cycling.
The Reid eComfort eBike is ideal for:

Everyday commuters looking for a comfortable electric commuter bike for travelling to work and getting around town

Leisure cyclists wanting to enjoy relaxed rides and longer journeys with the benefit of electric assistance

Riders tackling hills and headwinds, with electric assistance up to 20mph to help make challenging sections easier

Comfort-focused cyclists, with upright handlebars, ergonomic grips and a supportive comfort saddle

City and urban riding, with wide 27.5-inch tyres designed for stability and cushioning on roads and shared paths

Riders seeking reliable braking performance, with hydraulic disc brakes for responsive, controlled stopping

Cyclists who value connected technology, with an Ananda D19 display featuring Bluetooth technology and app compatibility

Riders who prefer simple gearing, with a 7-speed drivetrain suited to everyday cycling

Anyone looking for a practical alternative to driving, making daily journeys and leisure rides more convenient and enjoyable

Please make sure to familiarise yourself with eBike safety information before charging or using your new Reid. You can view and download user manuals and safety instructions here.
